rankings.blurb: Four Cornerstones. FOUR. Drake Maye, Jahmyr Gibbs, Puka Nacua, and Trey McBride walking around this roster like they own the place — because they do. Yes, you overpaid for Gibbs by KTC math, but when you're buying Cornerstones you don't haggle like you're at a garage sale. The only knock is you're riding with exactly one first-round pick going forward, so if this window closes, the rebuild is going to HURT — but right now this is the scariest roster in the league to play against.

Eleven Cornerstones and Foundational pieces — ELEVEN — and Ja'Marr Chase, JSN, and Drake London as your WR1-2-3 is absolutely disgusting. Jayden Daniels and Justin Herbert as your QB1 and QB2 is a problem other teams wish they had. The recent trades have been rough though, taking L after L to nchernandez in deals that stripped future capital, and you're now sitting on just one first-round pick — brother, you better win NOW because the future draft cupboard is looking thin.

Highest total dynasty value in the league at 155K and stacking SEVEN first-round picks like he's running a Costco for draft capital — jsinykin is playing chess while everyone else is playing checkers. Caleb Williams and Jaxson Dart as your QB room, Jeremiyah Love and Quinshon Judkins as your backfield future, and Harold Fannin at TE is a scary trajectory. The 'Reload' tag feels right because the roster isn't quite ready to win TODAY, but whoever plays this team in two years is going to be miserable.

Josh Allen at 9,998 KTC is basically printing money at the QB position, and pairing him with Ashton Jeanty and James Cook in the backfield is genuinely disgusting. The WR room of Garrett Wilson, Zay Flowers, and Jaylen Waddle is solid but not elite, and the TE spot is a work in progress with Sam LaPorta leading the charge. Gavin recently got fleeced giving away Tyler Shough and a first to Seth for a swap that helped Seth more than him, but the foundation here is strong enough to weather a couple bad trades — just stop letting Seth cook you.

Joe Burrow and Jalen Hurts at QB is a genuinely elite situation, and Amon-Ra St. Brown as your WR1 with Nico Collins behind him is respectable. But this team just got absolutely COOKED by nchernandez19 in a trade that sent Jameson Williams and two future firsts away for Malik Willis and Michael Wilson — that is the kind of transaction that gets discussed in league history for the wrong reasons. Zero first-round picks on the books going forward, and a RB room of Jonathan Taylor and Breece Hall that's aging in real time — GiantHawkTua is a contender right now but the clock is ticking loud.

Bijan Robinson and Brock Bowers as your two Cornerstones is an absolutely elite foundation, and this team has been ROBBING people in trades recently — six first-round picks stashed while everyone else is panic-selling future capital for win-now veterans. The QB room of Jordan Love and CJ Stroud is genuinely intriguing if either bounces back. The WR room is thin enough to make you sweat, but between the picks and the cornerstone talent, nchernandez19 is positioned to be a monster in 12-18 months.

Justin Jefferson and CeeDee Lamb as your top two WRs is genuinely elite and the kind of pairing that wins championships — in 2023. The problem is the rest of this roster reads like a fantasy graveyard: Christian McCaffrey on his last legs, Saquon Barkley collecting dust, Jared Goff and Sam Darnold playing QB musical chairs. One first-round pick to fix all of this? Grey, you have a window that's closing faster than your trade return on Mark Andrews. The 'Window Contender' tag is generous — this is more like 'hoping the stars align one more time.'

Lamar Jackson AND Patrick Mahomes at QB is a flex that would make any dynasty manager blush, but the rest of this roster is propped up with duct tape and prayers — Derrick Henry is the RB1, Travis Kelce is the TE1, and exactly zero future first-round picks are on the books. Zero. Herschey is running the boldest 'win now or bust' strategy in the league, and the RB situation behind Henry is genuinely embarrassing. This team wins a championship this year or we're writing its obituary — there is no middle ground.

Akracoon sold Ja'Marr Chase — a 9,978 KTC Cornerstone — and used the proceeds to stash picks and grab Ladd McConkey, who they THEN also traded away. The good news is seven first-round picks and Malik Nabers as your lone Cornerstone gives this rebuild a real foundation. The bad news is your QB room is Fernando Mendoza and Dak Prescott, your RB room is Bhayshul Tuten, and your TE room starts at David Njoku — this roster is one injury away from being unwatchable. Commit to the rebuild, trust the picks, and maybe eat some Skyline Chili while you wait two years for this to matter.

Seth has been wheeling and dealing his way into a pick hoard — five firsts, five firsts! — and he correctly identified that selling Jahmyr Gibbs at peak value to ekleiner1123 was a power move. But let's be honest: your current player roster is held together with Tyler Shough, TreVeyon Henderson, and vibes. George Pickens is your top player and your QB1 is a guy who threw seven touchdowns in the MAC last year. The picks make this rebuild interesting, but Seth better hit on a couple of these selections because right now the starters on this team couldn't win a pickup game.
